Use consistent units and check the assumptions below before applying the result.

How depreciation is calculated

Straight-line depreciation allocates the depreciable cost evenly across the useful life. Accounting and tax rules may prescribe a different method or first-year convention. Formula: Annual depreciation = (cost − salvage value) ÷ useful life. Use the displayed details to inspect the intermediate amounts and replace example assumptions with terms from your own quote or records.

Annual depreciation = (cost − salvage value) ÷ useful life.
A worked example

A $30,000 asset with $3,000 salvage over 5 years depreciates by $5,400 annually.
